resolution.note: failed worker turns record class, retryability, code, exit status and reset time

title: Record class, code, retryability and reset time of a failed worker turn
body:
Outcome: a failed worker round still exits 75, and result.json and error.json carry failure.class (from turn.error.codexErrorInfo), the JSON-RPC code, the process exit status, retryable and resetAt when present, without provider text.
Evidence: src/worker/driver.ts:367-369 throws one generic WorkerError(75, 'worker turn interrupted or failed'); driver.ts:64-74 completionSchema omits error; src/hosts/codex-app-server.ts:108,142 drop the exit status and the JSON-RPC code; test/fixtures/codex-app-server/failed-turn.rpc:15 holds the verbatim error notification with codexErrorInfo that KRN discards.
Source: finding CX2 in .krn/runs/lead/t3code-agentic/lanes/t3-codex-driver.md and OR3 in t3-orchestration.md (t3code types provider failures as class, code, retryable, resetAt; only usage_limit drives behaviour there).
Acceptance: (1) a replay test over failed-turn.rpc (a real capture) writes failure {class: modelNotFound, retryable: false} and no message text to result.json and error.json while the exit stays 75; (2) a table test covers every CodexErrorInfo variant named in the schema produced by `codex app-server generate-json-schema` (committed under test/fixtures/codex-app-server with provenance), so a new variant fails the test; (3) resetAt is covered by a frame labelled synthetic in provenance.json, or by a real-receiver capture produced by the mock-provider task (add `after: mock-provider`).

Delivered: failure {class, retryable, code?, exit_status?, signal?, reset_at?} in result.json and error.json; reset_at from account/rateLimits/read after limit classes (synthetic frame in test/fixtures/codex-app-server-schema); live usage-limit capture waits on t-m1jmgcv.
